**Review of head `1680446f4`: clean. No blocker.** A read-only Opus agent that did not write the change read it. A gate-runner that did not write the change ran the trial.

**Read (safety tier: this changes a collision check).**
- **No missed sample.** The old test keeps a sample when its distance to the disc centre is not more than `rad`, or is NaN. The query margin of the grid is `rad + 1e-9 * (rad + |c.x| + |c.y| + 1)`. That is about 10^7 times the rounding error, at each magnitude and near zero. `floor` is correct for negative coordinates. The cast to `i64` occurs only after `|t| <= 1e12`.
- **Fallbacks.** A NaN or infinite centre or radius reads all samples, as the old code did. A NaN, infinite or far sample is read by each query. A bad cell width reads all samples.
- **Dedup and order.** The verdict is a maximum with an early stop on a part hit. The warning order follows moves and groups, not samples. The sweep (c3) memoises by the same bits.
- **Reference.** `reach_reference.rs` is the old function, under `#[cfg(test)]`. The tests compare the full warning list in order on clear rings, part hits, a helix, ramps of 400, 500 and 2000 moves, leaning poses, and NaN or infinite moves.
- **Rules.** No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` outside tests. Memory and loops are bounded. Each file is under 400 lines. The decision file is present. No dependency, no golden moved.

**Notes, not blockers (test gaps):** no case asserts a stock-only shank hit; the fixtures have no negative coordinates and no sample exactly on a cell edge; no case reaches the `SPAN_LIMIT` fallback through the law. One comment in `reach_reference.rs:99` has wrongly encoded characters.

**Trial merge `f41ede5fb`** (not pushed; parents: main `b5ef7c39e` and this head; clean). Main is now `35e3bd173`; the difference is one app test file (#3603).
- `camcraft-sim`, lib and integration: 849 passed, 0 failed.
- App binaries: `mcp_verify` 3, `pocket_pass_start` 6 (98.4 s; 92.6 s on the head alone), `offset_pass_start` 4, `golden_cl` 33, `conformance` 7, `example_catalog` 37, `first_part_programs` 2; 0 failed.
- clippy with `-D warnings`: `camcraft-sim --all-targets`, `camcraft-sim` library only (no dead-code warning on `ReachStats`), `camcraft-app --lib`: clean.

No heavy lane ran (`P2`). The trial of #3577 on top of this change runs now.

Merge-ready: the collaborator review at head `1680446f4` (comment https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3595#issuecomment-7089972375 if the URL resolves) is clean, with no blocker; the body names sim 849 passed, `pocket_pass_start` 6/6 in about 93 s, and clippy clean. Nothing is pushed after this flag.

Route note: the merge route is the coordinator's. Another session of this account flagged this PR ready and merged it (`9a7de3781`). The review above (clean read, trial merge `f41ede5fb` on main `b5ef7c39e`, all green) is on the merged head `1680446f4`. Main was `35e3bd173` at the merge; the difference to the trial base is one app test file (#3603). The post-merge run of `9a7de3781` is the check of the tip.
